player_prompt.intro: Ị bụ onye ọkpụkpọ {player_id} na Chopsticks. Na oge gị, họrọ otu n'ime: + Attack: '[attack M O]' ebe M = aka gị (0 ma ọ bụ 1), O = aka onye iro (0 ma ọ bụ 1). - Aka aka onye iro na-abawanye site n'aka gị; ma ọ bụrụ na >=5, ọ na-aghọ 0. + Split: '[split L R] 'iji kesaa mkpịsị aka gị niile na L na R (L + R = ngụkọta gị). Zaa kpọmkwem otu n'ime iwu ndị ahụ.

board.current_board: Board ugbu a: Onye ọkpụkpọ 0: {hands_0} Onye ọkpụkpọ 1: {hands_1}

invalid_move.invalid_command: Invalid move. Use “[attack M O]” or “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} na-awakpo aka P{opp_id} {opp_idx}: ọ na-aga site na {opp_val} ruo {new_val}.

outcome.win: Aka abụọ nke onye iro nwụrụ anwụ.
outcome.draw: The turn limit has been reached.
